title: Malmgren helped Shoichiro Toyoda set up Toyota's headquarters in Kentucky

tellings.quote: We talked about Harold helping Shiro Toyota set up the Toyota headquarters in Kentucky.

plain: Harald Malmgren, a former presidential advisor on trade, helped Shoichiro Toyoda, the head of Toyota, set up the carmaker's headquarters in Kentucky in the 1980s. Michels says the two of them talked about this, relaying what Malmgren told him, as a sign of how far Malmgren's reach in business and government went.
